schema.description: Mechanical, from KHRONOS-GLTF-2.0 glTF.schema.json: the root object's properties (extensions and extras left out), each external $ref named in its description.

accessors.description: An array of accessors. Items follow accessor.schema.json.

animations.description: An array of animations. Items follow animation.schema.json.

bufferViews.description: An array of buffer views. Items follow bufferView.schema.json.

buffers.description: An array of buffers. Items follow buffer.schema.json.

cameras.description: An array of cameras. Items follow camera.schema.json.

extensionsRequired.description: Names of glTF extensions required to properly load the asset.

extensionsUsed.description: Names of glTF extensions used in the asset.

images.description: An array of images. Items follow image.schema.json.

materials.description: An array of materials. Items follow material.schema.json.

meshes.description: An array of meshes. Items follow mesh.schema.json.

nodes.description: An array of nodes. Items follow node.schema.json.

samplers.description: An array of samplers. Items follow sampler.schema.json.

scene.description: The index of the default scene. A glTFid (integer, minimum 0).

scenes.description: An array of scenes. Items follow scene.schema.json.

skins.description: An array of skins. Items follow skin.schema.json.

textures.description: An array of textures. Items follow texture.schema.json.

schema.title: glTF
